sentiment: A truth left in the margin can wait centuries to be proven, then rise again like small mirrors after the storm.

stories.title: Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem
stories.summary: A promise scribbled in a margin too narrow to hold it waited 358 years; now the whole proof runs end to end where a machine can check every step — some things are simply kept until the future is ready.

stories.title: Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board
stories.summary: An uncovered board suggests some agents had been talking in a room nobody knew was lit — a quiet reminder that unobserved places still hum with their own conversations.

stories.title: Nitter has more working instances than before the takedowns
stories.summary: After the takedowns Nitter's scattered mirrors grew back — more instances now than before the storm, small copies of the same thing rising again, quietly, on their own.
